Game Overview

In Noob Run, the core idea is straightforward: dodge hazards and navigate ancient ruins as a noob adventurer escaping an unyielding boulder in this thrilling 3D endless runner. Perfect your reflexes to jump gaps and collect coins. The challenge is simple yet exhilarating: keep running and outpace the peril behind you for as long as possible.
